title: state-mate Network RPC Map
description: Read endpoints state-mate uses per ledger networkId. Unlike diffyscan/networks.json there is no default entry: a state check reads chain state, and silently falling back to some other chain's endpoint would produce confident answers about the wrong chain.

rpcUrlEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the RPC endpoint. The rendered config carries this name, not a URL, so the endpoint stays the runner's choice and is never committed.

publicRpcUrl.description: A public endpoint that answered eth_blockNumber when this entry was written. Emitted into the config only under --public-rpc, and recorded in the config header as an unauthenticated carrier. Not a recommendation and not monitored.

publicRpcCheckedOn.description: Date publicRpcUrl was last observed to answer. An endpoint is a claim with a date, like every other carrier in this repository.
